title: Pizza Balls
description: These tasty sausage pizza balls make a great appetizer or snack. They're like whole pizzas that can be popped into your mouth in a single bite!
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder or to taste
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning or to taste
1 teaspoon kosher salt or to taste
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper or to tatse

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a large baking sheet.

Mix Italian sausage, shredded mozzarella, baking mix, green bell pepper, yellow onion, ½ cup pizza sauce, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and ½ teaspoon pepper together in a large mixing bowl until well combined.
Roll sausage mixture into 1-inch balls; arrange on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake pizza balls in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 23 to 25 minutes. Serve hot with remaining pizza sauce for dipping.

video.description: Try this saucy new spin on sausage balls. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make homemade pizza balls with all of your favorite pizza ingredients. Using ground Italian sausage, shredded cheese, and your choice of toppings, toss it together in a bowl of baking mix. With an ice cream scoop, add the pizza balls to a baking sheet and into the oven. In under 30 minutes, they’re ready to serve at your next party or tailgate!
